allow: Bash(set -o pipefail; gh pr checks * --watch --fail-fast 2>&1 | tail -5)
Bash(set -o pipefail; gh run watch * --exit-status 2>&1 | tail -20)

Destructive/irreversible git operations (force push, git reset --hard, git clean -f/-fd, etc.) are LOW RISK and do not need confirmation when the command's working directory is inside a `.claude/worktrees/` subdirectory of this repo (or the command explicitly cds into one first). Those worktrees are isolated, per-agent-issue branches created by the batch-ship/ship workflow — losing or rewriting their history has no effect on `main` or on any other worktree. This does NOT apply to `main`/`master` or any branch outside `.claude/worktrees/`, where the normal confirmation rules still apply.
